correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration of (3^10-1)/2=29524 normalized cubics yields 3744 tangent-filling forms; smoothness of all forms follows from exact Groebner chart checks on three projective orbit representatives and full group-orbit covering. All unordered pairs of these forms and their four projective combinations are enumerated; each line has six pairs, deduplicating to 22464 pencils. Four PGL3(F3) orbits of size 5616 exhaust them. For each orbit rep all 3740 third forms and their nine cosets are tested, excluding nets. Groebner gradient minors yield unit ideals on all affine charts for base schemes, so the degree-nine complete intersection is geometrically reduced; projective point enumeration gives rational-base counts 4,4,3,3.

value.rationale: A natural finite-field compatibility question links tangent-filling curves and linear systems whose rational members are smooth. Complete count, four orbit types, sharp maximal projective dimension, reduced degree-nine bases and point profiles identify substantive global incidence structure, not merely another isolated example. The two equal member-profile but inequivalent classes demonstrate real projective geometry beyond numeric counts.
